name: EIA: most combined-cycle plants have duct burners
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. US combined-cycle fleet 278 GW, of which about 208 GW (about 75%) has duct burners; 2020 capacity factor 59% with duct firing versus 47% without (EIA-860/EIA-923). Evidence: https://www.eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=52778
